subject: Quote for quarterly gloves and safety glasses

Hi team,

I'm Head of Procurement at Northwind Logistics. We run 3 warehouses and need a quarterly contract for nitrile gloves and safety glasses, roughly 5,000 boxes of gloves per quarter. Can you send volume pricing and set up a call this week? Our current supplier contract ends Nov 15.

Maria Chen
